description: This file provides functions for fetching and processing weather data from the OpenWeatherMap API, including retrieving API keys, fetching current weather by coordinates or city, and generating weather summaries and activity recommendations based on weather conditions. It also contains utility functions for handling date and time parsing.

methods.name: str get_openweather_api_key()
methods.description: Retrieve OpenWeatherMap API key from environment variables, checking multiple variable names and raising error if missing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] fetch_current_weather_by_coords(lat: float, lon: float)
methods.description: Fetch current weather data from OpenWeatherMap API using latitude and longitude.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] fetch_current_weather_by_city(city: str, state: Optional[str] = None, country: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetch current weather data from OpenWeatherMap API using city, state, and country.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[float],Optional[float]] weather_summary(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Create a simplified weather summary, extracting description, temperature, and precipitation info from API payload.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] recommend_activity(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Provide weather-based activity recommendations based on weather conditions, including severity and suggested actions.

methods.name: datetime parse_iso_datetime(value: str)
methods.description: Parse ISO-8601 date string into timezone-aware UTC datetime.

methods.name: datetime safe_now_utc()
methods.description: Get current UTC time with timezone info.

methods.name: bool within_time_window(target: datetime, start: datetime, end: datetime)
methods.description: Check if a datetime falls within a specified start and end datetime interval.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] msg(title: str, suggestion: str, color: str)
